verses.tl: Bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem
Alif-laam-meem
Ghulibatir-room
Fee adnal-ardi wa hum min ba'di ghalabihim sayaghliboon
Fee bid'i sineena Lillaahil-amru min qablu wa min ba'du wa yawma'idhin yafrahul-mu'minoon
Binasri Allaahi yansuru man yashaa'u wa huwal-azeezur-Raheem
Wa'da Allaahi laa yukhlifu Allaahu wa'dahu wa laakinna aktharan-naasi laa ya'lamoon
Ya'lamoona zaahiran minal-hayaatid-dunyaa wa hum anil-aakhirati hum ghaafiloon
Awalam yatafakkaroo fee anfusihim maa khalaqa Allaahus-samaawaati wal-arda wa maa baynahumaa illaa bil-haqqi wa ajalin musamman wa inna katheeran minan-naasi biliqaa'i rabbihim lakaafiroon

Awalam yaseeroo fil-ardi fayanzuroo kayfa kaana aaqibatul-ladheena min qablihim kaanoo ashadda minhum quwwatan wa athaarul-arda wa amaroohaa akthara mimmaa amaroohaa wa jaa'athum rusuluhum bil-bayyinaati famaa kaana Allaahu liyazlimahum wa laakin kaanoo anfusahum yazlimoon
Thumma kaana aaqibatal-ladheena asaa'us-soo'aa an kadhdhaboo bi-aayaati Allaahi wa kaanoo bihaa yastahzi'oon
Allaahu yabda'ul-khalqa thumma yu'eeduhu thumma ilayhi turja'oon
Wa yawma taqoomus-saa'atu yublisul-mujrimoon
Wa lam yakun lahum min shurakaa'ihim shufa'aa'u wa kaanoo bishurakaa'ihim kaafireen
Wa yawma taqoomus-saa'atu yawma'idhin yatafarraqoon
Fa-ammal-ladheena aamanoo wa amilus-saalihaati fahum fee rawdatin yuhbaroon
Wa ammal-ladheena kafaroo wa kadhdhaboo bi-aayaatinaa wa liqaa'il-aakhirati fa-ulaa'ika fil-adhaabi muhdaroon
Fasubhaana Allaahi heena tumsoona wa heena tusbihoon
Wa lahul-hamdu fis-samaawaati wal-ardi wa ashiyyan wa heena tuzhiroon
Yukhrijul-hayya minal-mayyiti wa yukhrijul-mayyita minal-hayyi wa yuhyil-arda ba'da mawtihaa wa kadhalika tukhrajoon
Wa min aayaatihi an khalaqakum min turaabin thumma idhaa antum basharun tantashiroon
Wa min aayaatihi an khalaqa lakum min anfusikum azwaajan litaskunoo ilayhaa wa ja'ala baynakum mawaddatan wa rahmatan inna fee dhaalika la-aayaatin liqawmin yatafakkaroon
Wa min aayaatihi khalqus-samaawaati wal-ardi wakhtilaafu alsinatikum wa alwaanikum inna fee dhaalika la-aayaatin lil-aalimeen
Wa min aayaatihi manaamukum bil-layli wan-nahaari wabtighaa'uukum min fadlihi inna fee dhaalika la-aayaatin liqawmin yasma'oon
Wa min aayaatihi yureekumul-barqa khawfan wa tama'an wa yunazzilu minas-samaa'i maa'an fayuhyee bihil-arda ba'da mawtihaa inna fee dhaalika la-aayaatin liqawmin ya'qiloon
Wa min aayaatihi an taqoomas-samaa'u wal-ardu bi-amrihi thumma idhaa da'aakum da'watan minal-ardi idhaa antum takhrujoon
Wa lahu man fis-samaawaati wal-ardi kullun lahu qaanitoon
Wa huwal-ladhee yabda'ul-khalqa thumma yu'eeduhu wa huwa ahwanu alayhi wa lahul-mathalul-a'laa fis-samaawaati wal-ardi wa huwal-azeezul-hakeem

Daraba lakum mathalan min anfusikum hal lakum min maa malakat aymaanukum min shurakaa'a fee maa razaqnaakum fa-antum feehi sawaa'un takhaafoonahum kakheefatikum anfusakum kadhaalika nufassilul-aayaati liqawmin ya'qiloon
Bal ittaba'al-ladheena zalamoo ahwaa'ahum bighayri ilmin faman yahdee man adalla Allaahu wa maa lahum min naasireen
Fa-aqim wajhaka lid-deeni haneefan fitrata Allaahil-latee fataran-naasa alayhaa laa tabdeela likhalqi Allaahi dhaalikad-deenul-qayyimu wa laakinna aktharan-naasi laa ya'lamoon
Muneebeena ilayhi wattaqoohu wa aqeemus-salaata wa laa takoonoo minal-mushrikeen
Minal-ladheena farraqoo deenahum wa kaanoo shiya'an kullu hizbin bimaa ladayhim farihoon
Wa idhaa massan-naasa durrun da'aw rabbahum muneebeena ilayhi thumma idhaa adhaaqahum minhu rahmatan idhaa fareequn minhum birabbihim yushrikoon
Liyakfuroo bimaa aataynaahum fatamatta'oo fasawfa ta'lamoon
Am anzalnaa alayhim sultaanan fahuwa yatakallamu bimaa kaanoo bihi yushrikoon
Wa idhaa adhaqnan-naasa rahmatan farihoo bihaa wa in tusibhum sayyi'atun bimaa qaddamat aydeehim idhaa hum yaqnatoon
Awalam yaraw annallaaha yabsutur-rizqa liman yashaa'u wa yaqdiru inna fee dhaalika la-aayaatin liqawmin yu'minoon
Fa-aati dhal-qurbaa haqqahu wal-miskeena wabnas-sabeeli dhaalika khayrun lilladheena yureedoona wajha Allaahi wa ulaa'ika humul-muflihoon
Wa maa aataytum min riban liyarbuwaa fee amwaalin-naasi falaa yarboo indallaahi wa maa aataytum min zakaatin tureedoona wajha Allaahi fa-ulaa'ika humul-mud'ifoon
Allaahul-ladhee khalaqakum thumma razaqakum thumma yumeetukum thumma yuhyeekum hal min shurakaa'ikum man yaf'alu min dhaalikum min shay'in subhaanahu wa ta'aalaa ammaa yushrikoon
Zaharal-fasaadu fil-barri wal-bahri bimaa kasabat aydin-naasi liyudheeqahum ba'dal-ladhee amiloo la-allahum yarji'oon
Qul seeroo fil-ardi fanzuroo kayfa kaana aaqibatul-ladheena min qablu kaana aktharuhum mushrikeen
Fa-aqim wajhaka lid-deenil-qayyimi min qabli an ya'tiya yawmun laa maradda lahu mina Allaahi yawma'idhin yassadda'oon
Man kafara fa-alayhi kufruhu wa man amila saalihan fali'anfusihim yamhadoon
Liyajziyal-ladheena aamanoo wa amilus-saalihaati min fadlihi innahu laa yuhibbul-kaafireen
Wa min aayaatihi an yursilar-riyaaha mubashshiraatin wa liyudheeqakum min rahmatihi wa litajriyal-fulku bi-amrihi wa litabtaghoo min fadlihi wa la-allakum tashkuroon
Wa laqad arsalnaa min qablika rusulan ilaa qawmihim fajaa'oohum bil-bayyinaati fantaqamnaa minal-ladheena ajramoo wa kaana haqqan alaynaa nasrul-mu'mineen

Allaahul-ladhee yursilur-riyaaha fatutheeru sahaaban fayabsutuhu fis-samaa'i kayfa yashaa'u wa yaj'aluhu kisafan fataral-wadqa yakhruju min khilaalihi fa-idhaa asaaba bihi man yashaa'u min ibaadihi idhaa hum yastabshiroon
Wa in kaanoo min qabli an yunazzala alayhim min qablihi lamubliseen
Fanzur ilaa aathaari rahmati Allaahi kayfa yuhyil-arda ba'da mawtihaa inna dhaalika lamuhyil-mawtaa wa huwa alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
Wa la-in arsalnaa reehan fara'awhu musfarran lazalloo min ba'dihi yakfuroon
Fa-innaka laa tusmi'ul-mawtaa wa laa tusmi'us-summad-du'aa'a idhaa wallaw mudbireen
Wa maa anta bihaadil-umyi an dalaalatihim in tusmi'u illaa man yu'minu bi-aayaatinaa fahum muslimoon
Allaahul-ladhee khalaqakum min da'fin thumma ja'ala min ba'di da'fin quwwatan thumma ja'ala min ba'di quwwatin da'fan wa shaybatan yakhluqu maa yashaa'u wa huwal-aleemul-qadeer
Wa yawma taqoomus-saa'atu yuqsimul-mujrimoona maa labithoo ghayra saa'atin kadhaalika kaanoo yu'ufakoon
Wa qaalal-ladheena ootul-ilma wal-eemaana laqad labithtum fee kitaabillaahi ilaa yawmil-ba'thi fahadhaa yawmul-ba'thi wa laakinnakum kuntum laa ta'lamoon
Fayawma'idhin laa yanfa'ul-ladheena zalamoo ma'dhiratuhum wa laa hum yusta'taboon
Wa laqad darabnaa lin-naasi fee haadhal-qur'aani min kulli mathalin wa la-in ji'tahum bi-aayatin layaqoolannal-ladheena kafaroo in antum illaa mubtiloon
Kadhaalika yatba'u Allaahu alaa quloobil-ladheena laa ya'lamoon
Fasbir inna wa'da Allaahi haqqun wa laa yastakhiffannakal-ladheena laa yooqinoon
